summary: More ansible.builtin.iptables examples: insert a rule at rule_num 5, set the INPUT policy to DROP, reject_with tcp-reset, tcp_flags, flush filter and nat chains in a loop, log with limit and log_prefix, and destination_ports for several ports or ranges.
questions: How do I insert an iptables rule at a specific position?
How do I flush iptables chains with Ansible?
How do I open multiple ports with one iptables task?
How do I set the default policy to DROP?
